description: This file defines schema components and utility functions for supporting tables in a ProseMirror-based editor, including node specifications for table rows, cells, headers, and functions for handling cell attributes.

methods.name: getCellAttrs
methods.description: Extracts cell attributes from a DOM element, including colspan, rowspan, and colwidth, merging in extra attributes.

methods.name: setCellAttrs
methods.description: Generates cell attributes for a node, including colspan, rowspan, and colwidth, and applies extra attributes via setters.

methods.name: validateColwidth
methods.description: Validates that the colwidth attribute is either null or an array of numbers.

methods.name: tableNodes
methods.description: Creates node specifications for table, row, cell, and header nodes with configurable content and attributes.

methods.name: tableNodeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves node types for table roles (table, row, cell, header) from a schema, caching the result.
